questions.question_text: Evaluate $\sin 62^{\circ}$, $\cos 40^{\circ}$ and $\tan 41^{\circ}$ correct to $4$ decimal places. Which is the smallest?

options.why: Tangent has been assumed to always give the smallest value, but $\tan 41^{\circ}=0.8693$ is larger than $\cos 40^{\circ}=0.7660$.
Only the angle sizes have been compared and the largest angle picked; $\sin 62^{\circ}=0.8829$ is in fact the largest value.
